name: Albcontrol (Air Navigation Services of Albania)
notes: albcontrol.al About Us page: the National Air Traffic Agency (ANTA) was founded in 1992, became a joint stock company in 1999, was renamed ALBCONTROL in 2013, and is now the public non-budgetary entity Albcontrol established by law no. 40/2024 as Albania's air navigation service provider. Logo is the header PNG (red and navy wordmark with the line 'Air Navigation Services of Albania') served by albcontrol.al, tier 2, website-served; no brand page, press kit or logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.
